run_human_agent_interactive_session: run an interactive AndroidEnv session where a human controls the agent via pygame mouse clicks
create_android_env_config: create an AndroidEnvConfig with emulator launcher and ADB controller settings for a task
get_action_from_pygame_event: create a function that converts a pygame mouse click event into an AndroidEnv touch or lift action
scale_mouse_position_for_orientation: create a function that scales raw mouse coordinates to normalized floats adjusted for screen orientation
render_pygame_frame_from_timestep: create a function that renders an AndroidEnv observation frame onto a pygame display surface
